question: By whom and by what path is the sequence of bliss definitively ascertained?
premises: Bliss is considered to have a sequence.
Ascertainment requires an agent and a path.
The agent and path of this ascertainment are questioned.
inference: No definite agent or path can be established for fixing the sequence of bliss.
plain_english: By whom and by what path has the sequence of bliss been ascertained?
